preconditions.description: The number of queries t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The order of the graph n is between 1 and 1,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**16 and 1 <= bi <= 10**16 and ai != bi for ai, bi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two distinct vertices ai and bi, each between 1 and 10^16 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of queries t.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(length, int) and length >= 0 for length in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the length of the shortest path.
